form.title: Initial and Annual Statement of Qualified Opportunity Fund (QOF) Investments
form.notes: The QOF INVESTOR's statement, filed every year a deferral is held. It does not compute gain: the deferral itself is reported on Form 8949 — its own row in Part I (box C or I) or Part II (box F or L) with code "Z" in column (f) and the deferred gain as a negative number in column (g); an inclusion is reported with code "Y" and the previously deferred gain as a positive number (i8949, "How To Report an Election To Defer Tax on Eligible Gain Invested in a QOF"). So a K-1 or 1099 deferral reaches 1040 7a through Form 8949, and Form 8997 is the inventory beside it. Its instructions are printed on the form itself (pages 3-4).
